$jsonSchema.title: PaymentException
$jsonSchema.description: Stage 9 — one document per exception occurrence (doc 24 B2): a settlement that came back unmatched/returned/delayed, a reconciliation discrepancy, or a duplicate-content signal. Doina's alignment row 9 (Sep 17 L1577) says 'exceptions created' and names no v14 domain ('modeled as a state/action within the originating domain'); the collection is her TBD #13 (L1414) — 0 matches in the canonical spec (verified by count), so the shape is authored here and ratified via Q60. The reserved nullable agent{} subdoc is where the Reconciliation Agent's output lands (L1319-1323, Q61); category 'UTA' and actions 'REPAIR'/'RETURN' are reserved for the incoming flow (FR-9.IN4 / DR-9.IN1, Q64) and are never written by the outgoing path. No collection validator is applied (Q9, like every prior authored collection).

paymentId.description: Back-reference to payments.paymentId. The Operations queue joins on this; payments carries no refs[] array of exception ids (doc 24 B2).

category.description: UTA reserved for the incoming Repair/Return flow (FR-9.IN4) — never written by the outgoing path.

status.description: OPEN until an operator resolves (RESOLVED) or dismisses (DISMISSED) via POST /workflow/exceptions/{id}/resolve. The payment's own terminal state never reopens (doc 24 B4).

severity.description: DUPLICATE_SIGNAL is the only INFORMATIONAL category this stage writes.

stage.description: The lifecycle stage whose detection raised the exception.

detail.description: Per-category payload, populated from the stamps the producers already write. Amounts are MAJOR units (float dollars), matching payments.amount / clearing.discrepancyAmount. Nullable members; only the keys relevant to the category are set.

discrepancyAmount.description: SETTLEMENT_UNMATCHED / RECONCILIATION_DISCREPANCY: expected minus received, major units.

actualAmount.description: Major units; 0 when nothing settled back.

duplicateOf.description: DUPLICATE_SIGNAL: the paymentId this one resembles (duplicate_detection WARN detail).

resolution.description: Null while OPEN. Written by the resolve endpoint (doc 24 B4): the action taken, by whom, when, and the operator's note (the resolution log, R5).

action.description: REPAIR/RETURN reserved for incoming UTA (FR-9.IN2) — never written this stage.

by.description: 'payments-operations' for an operator action; a service actor when the system auto-resolves (e.g. RETRY_SETTLEMENT landing MATCHED).

agent.description: Reserved null in Phase 1 (R12: 'will not create a new agent here'). The Reconciliation Agent's output lands here (Sep 17 L1319-1323): investigation result, likely root cause, supporting evidence, confidence, recommended resolution. Shape ratified via Q61.

sourceSystem.description: Which service wrote the occurrence. Follows the reconciliationItems convention ('ledger-service'), NOT the payments/transactions docs' 'leafy-bank-payments-service'.
